title: Open restriction of a single intrinsic tensor test
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, j:U→X an open immersion of schemes and K an arbitrary object of the intrinsic constant-A pro-etale derived category [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Let a,b be integers and assume Lj^*K has intrinsic Tor amplitude [a,b] [def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude]. For arbitrary complexes L,Q of A_X-module sheaves, an isomorphism Q_D(L)≅K, a quasi-isomorphism f:Q→L, and acyclic-tensor K-flat Q, let M be any A_X-module sheaf. For every integer q<a or b<q, j^* H^q(derivedTensor(L,M[0],Q,f)) is zero [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves, def-weil-derived-tensor]. No origin, boundedness or constructibility is imposed on M or K. No covering family is involved.

source.place: Step 4: restriction of one arbitrary module-sheaf tensor test before cover detection

proof.text: Use the exact intrinsic coefficient realization equivalence to write K as the realization of K′ and M as the realization of a fixed-scalar sheaf N, with the counit identifications. The unit-normalized openSquarePullbackModel conjugates the specified constant-ring pullback to fixed-scalar inverse image. Apply termwise localization to this natural isomorphism. It identifies the realization of j^*K′ with Lj^*K. Tor amplitude is invariant under isomorphism by composition of the representative isomorphism in its definition.

Apply intrinsic_hasProEtaleTorAmplitude_iff_torAmplitudeIn on U. Test the resulting fixed-scalar Tor bound against j^*N. Its tensor homology in degree q is zero. The exact fixed-scalar inverse image is strong monoidal (monoidal_upperStar), so it has the proved source comparison mapDerivedCategoryTensorComparison; compose its component with mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor to identify restriction of K′ tensor-derived N[0] with j^*K′ tensor-derived (j^*N)[0]. This is the finite, single-test pullback/tensor computation, with no integral or common-stage coherence needed.

Apply intrinsic_resolution_tensor_homology_iso to the given L,Q,f and M with their isomorphisms. Pull back that isomorphism; compose the realization/pullback comparison and the exact homology comparison with the tensor comparison from the preceding step. The zero tensor homology on U is sent to zero by the additive realization. Transport across the resulting isomorphism to obtain the requested zero sheaf.

lean.statement:
theorem purityOpenTensorTestVanishing
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {U X : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (K : proEtaleDerivedCategory X A) (a b : ℤ)
    (hK : HasProEtaleTorAmplitude U A
      ((proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback A j).obj K) a b)
    (L Q : CochainComplex (proEtaleRingModules X (proEtaleConstantRing X A)) ℤ)
    (e : Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj L ≅ K))
    (f : Q ⟶ L) (hf : QuasiIso f)
    (hQ : CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := proEtaleConstantRing X A) Q)
    (M : proEtaleRingModules X (proEtaleConstantRing X A))
    (q : ℤ) (hq : q < a ∨ b < q) :
    IsZero ((proEtaleConstantRingPullback A j).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
        (derivedTensor X A L
          ((HomologicalComplex.single _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).obj M) Q f hf hQ)))
